examples.detection_method: Email security gateway detecting anomalous subdomain URL patterns and newly registered domain with privacy protection; sandbox detonation of PDF attachment revealing macro or embedded malware; user behavioral analytics flagging anomalous access to payment confirmation link; WAF signatures triggering on suspicious DNS subdomain chaining; manual user training to identify unusual sender domain and unexpected invoice.
